facts.fact: The FY2026/27 estimates give the Department of Shared Digital Services, under the Ministry of Communications and Innovation, a recurrent estimate of BWP 587,310,850, financed from domestic revenue.
facts.system: Department of Shared Digital Services recurrent estimate 2026/27

facts.fact: The document gives the digital ministry's overall recurrent estimate for FY2026/27 as BWP 949,920,900, down 1.7% on FY2025/26.
